data.title: KYC Verification Bot Circumvention Detection
data.description: Detect automated circumvention of KYC identity verification processes: (1) liveness check submissions exhibiting synthetic face indicators such as GAN artifacts or uniform skin texture, (2) document photo lighting conditions inconsistent with selfie environment suggesting pre-captured or generated images, (3) multiple verification attempts from geographically dispersed IP addresses using the same identity documents, (4) session duration and interaction patterns matching known automation tooling.

detection.condition: selection_synthetic or selection_lighting or selection_multi_ip or selection_automation

enrichment_required.source: Biometric analysis enrichment (GAN artifact and synthetic face detection scoring)
Document analysis enrichment (lighting environment consistency check)

falsepositives: Poor camera quality producing artifacts similar to GAN indicators
Unusual lighting conditions during legitimate verification
Users re-attempting verification from different networks (mobile vs wifi)
